title: Astrofizz | Snacks at Magic Kingdom | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: AstrofizzHosted by Coca-Cola® Located in Tomorrowland at Magic Kingdom Park Fuel up at this space-age stand featuring buttery popcorn and fluffy cotton candy. Then, before you blast off again, cool off with a refreshing beverage—like frozen slushies or assorted Coca-Cola® Fountain Beverages.View Menu American Mobile Orders Snack Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM Valid admission required.
